title: 第16章 魔晶交易第17章 镇压
content_zh:
第十六章 魔晶交易
“干什么的？”林立抹了把冷汗，正要往小屋里走，却不料两条大汉走过来，抬手就把他给挡在了门外。
两条大汉都打着赤膊，神色凶狠一脸横肉，一看就是在打打杀杀中厮混出来的，林立摸了摸鼻子，带着几分怯意小声答道：“卖东西的……”
“卖东西滚一边去！也他妈不照照镜子，加洛斯交易所也是你能随便乱进的？”说着就把林立给推到了门外。
林立被推得连连后退：“有话好好说，别推行不行？”
“赶快滚！”
见林立还要罗嗦，两人顿时就火了，捏起拳头就要动手。
凯文正在那喘着粗气，刚一抬头就看见双方冲突，再想要开口阻止已经有些来不及了，见那大汉动手，年轻魔法师不得不遗憾的叹了口气。
“啊！”
跟着就是两声惨叫接连传来，惊得那喧闹的黑市，也仿佛在忽然之间静了下来。
“妈的，真以为穿着长袍的就是斯文人？”林立笑得一脸阳光，围观群众怎么也想不明白，这个看似无害的少年法师，怎么下起手来却出奇的毒辣，两条大汉连爪子都还没来得及递出去，就一人一发奥术飞弹给轰出了十几米远，此时正躺在地上发出一阵阵痛苦的呻吟。
“现在，我可以进去卖东西了吗？”林立笑咪咪的走了过去，弯下腰去向正痛苦呻吟的两人问道。
可怜两人不过是地痞流氓，在这里看门也大多只是欺负欺负落魄冒险者，又几时撞上过真正的魔法师，那两记奥术飞弹虽是低级魔法，可这么结结实实的轰在胸口，身体再强壮也得被轰去半条命，此时见了林立，就好象是见了鬼一样，惊惶之下连连点头：“可以可以……”
林立这才露出满意的笑容，往前走出几步，又有些不太放心的问了一句：“不会被赶出来吧？”
“不会不会不会……”
一旁的凯文看得目瞪口呆，过了好一会才有些无奈的叹了口气，这少年法师跟葛瑞安叔叔的性格倒真是挺象，都是一样的睚眦必报下手狠辣，难怪葛瑞安叔叔这么看重他……
在两个倒霉鬼痛苦的呻吟声中，林立神清气爽的走进了交易所。
凯文追上来，露出一脸的苦笑：“加洛斯交易所是会员制的，我都还没来得及掏会员卡，你就把人给揍了，这手动得也太快了……”
“怎么？”林立笑咪咪的随口问了一句：“有后台？”
“当然了，象加洛斯交易所这样的地方，怎么可能不受某支势力保护。”说起这个凯文就有点头疼：“保护这里的是老奥丁，加洛斯最大的地下势力——不过这不是重点，关键是老奥丁跟魔法公会关系一向良好，跟葛瑞安会长更是从小就认识的朋友，你这么不声不响的把人给揍了，葛瑞安会长不好跟老奥丁交代……”

“反正揍都揍了，等他找上门来再说吧。”
加洛斯交易所内空荡荡的，除了一个正靠在柜台上打盹的老头之外，连个鬼影子都看不到，林立进去一连敲了几十下柜台，那老头才带着一脸惺忪的睡意张开眼来，一边打着呵欠，还一边小声抱怨着：“现在的年轻人可真缺德，连老人家偶尔偷懒睡个觉都要吵醒，哎……年纪这么大了，也不知道还能好好的睡上几次觉……”
林立郁闷的摸了摸鼻子，这老家伙简直比葛瑞安还能扯……
“有什么事赶紧说，别耽误老人家休息。”老头的声音有气无力，听起来就好象快断气了似的。
“听朋友说加洛斯交易所收购各种魔法材料，我手上又正好有几枚魔晶，就想拿过来看看能不能换点钱周转周转。”对方毕竟上了年纪，不象门外那两个倒霉鬼身强力壮，林立就算心里再怎么不爽，也只能强自按捺着怒气。
说完也不跟老头罗嗦，从怀里掏出伊娜送给自己的卷轴袋来。
接着就听见一阵“哗啦哗啦”的声响，数十枚魔晶骨碌骨碌的就滚到了柜台上。
看着那一枚枚亮晶的魔晶，一旁的凯文当时就觉得头皮发麻，他甚至不需要仔细看，光凭魔晶上透出的元素波动，也可以感受出它们至少都在五级以上，魔兽可不是谁家里养的奶牛，可以想挤就挤，这么几十枚五级以上的魔晶，就算是出动一支佣兵团队，怕是也要花上十几天的时间。
凯文真是怎么也想不明白，这么多高品质魔晶，怎么就落到了林立一个人手上……
而反应最大的，还是柜台后的老头。
这老家伙刚刚还一副昏昏欲睡的样子，此时大量魔晶从卷轴袋中滚出，老头当场就两眼发亮，“噌”的一下从椅子上蹦了起来，整个人都扑到了柜台上面，反应之迅速动作之敏捷，又哪来一点上了年纪的样子？
“狮蝎……嗜血蜥蜴……雷兽，我靠！怎么还有双足飞龙的！”只见老头两眼放光，趴在柜台上一枚接一枚的数着，或是轻声低语或是大声惊呼，那神情那眼色，真是要多变态就有多变态。
“这……这些都是你的？”两人在那等了足有大半个小时，老家伙才从一堆魔晶中抬起头来，望向林立的目光，就好象是大灰狼见了小白兔一样。
“基本上，是这么回事……”
林立硬着头皮点了点头，正打算问他收不收的时候，老头却已经是一拍桌子：“一共八千金币，卖不卖？”
“八千金币？”林立有点茫然，身为一名穿越者，他对安瑞尔世界的金钱实在没什么概念，只得扭过头去，向凯文投去求助的目光。
“一万！”凯文斩钉截铁的吐出一个数字。
“等等……我需要商量一下。”
一万金币毕竟是个很大的数目，老头也不敢独自拿主意，只是跟两人说了一声之后，就匆匆忙忙的出了柜台，两人又在那等了很久之后，才看到老头一脸喜色的回来，这一次他没有半点犹豫，直接就把那数十枚魔晶给收了起来：“成交！”
content_en:
Chapter 16 Magic Crystal Trading
"What are you doing?" Lin Li wiped his cold sweat and was about to walk into the hut, but unexpectedly two big men came over and blocked him out of the door with their hands raised.
The two big men were shirtless, with fierce expressions on their faces. It looked like they had gotten together in a fight. Lin Li touched his nose and replied in a low voice with a bit of timidity: "The seller..."
"Go away from selling things! Why don't you look in the mirror? You can just enter the Garos Exchange?" With that, he pushed Lin Li out of the door.
Lin Li was pushed back repeatedly: "If you have something to say, please say it well and don't push it through, okay?"
"Get out of here!"
Seeing that Lin Li was still wordy, the two of them immediately became angry and clenched their fists to make a move.
Kevin was breathing heavily. As soon as he raised his head, he saw the conflict between the two sides. It was already too late to stop him. Seeing the big man take action, the young magician had to sigh with regret.
"Ah!"
Then two screams came one after another, shocking the noisy black market to seem to suddenly become silent.
"Damn it, do you really think those in robes are gentlemen?" Lin Li smiled with a bright smile on his face. The onlookers couldn't figure out how this seemingly harmless young mage could be so vicious in his attacks. Before the two big men even had time to extend their claws, they blasted each of them ten meters away with arcane missiles. They were lying on the ground moaning in pain.
"Now, can I go in and sell things?" Lin Li walked over with a smile, bent down and asked the two men who were groaning in pain.
It's a pity that the two of them are just hooligans. Most of the gatekeepers here only bully down-and-out adventurers, and they have bumped into real magicians a few times. Although the two arcane missiles were low-level magic, they hit their chests so solidly that no matter how strong they were, half of their lives were taken away. When they saw Lin Li, they felt as if they had seen a ghost. He nodded in panic: "Okay, okay..."
Lin Li then showed a satisfied smile, took a few steps forward, and asked a little uneasily: "You won't be kicked out, will you?"
"No, no, no, no..."
Kevin on the side looked dumbfounded. After a while, he sighed helplessly. The personalities of this young mage and Uncle Greg were quite similar. They both had the same tendency to retaliate harshly. No wonder Uncle Greg valued him so much...
Amidst the painful groans of the two unfortunate ghosts, Lin Li walked into the exchange refreshed.
Kevin caught up with him and showed a wry smile: "Garos Exchange is membership-only. You beat him up before I even had time to take out my membership card. You moved too fast..."
"What?" Lin Li smiled and asked casually: "Is there a backstage?"
"Of course, how could a place like the Garos Exchange not be protected by a certain force." Speaking of this, Kevin had a headache: "The person who protects this place is Old Odin, the largest underground force in Garos - but this is not the point. The key is that Old Odin has always had a good relationship with the Magic Guild, and he and President Grean have been friends since childhood. You beat someone up so quietly, President Grean can't explain to old Odin..."
"I've beaten him anyway, let's wait until he comes to the door."
The Garros Exchange was empty. Except for an old man who was taking a nap on the counter, not even a ghost could be seen. Lin Li went in and knocked on the counter dozens of times. The old man opened his eyes with a sleepy look on his face. He yawned and complained in a low voice: "Young people nowadays are so wicked. They even wake up the elderly when they occasionally take a nap. Hey... at such an old age, I don't know how many times I can sleep well..."
Lin Li touched his nose depressedly. This old guy was even more ridiculous than Greg...
"If you have anything to say, hurry up and don'tDelay the elderly's rest. "The old man's voice was weak, as if he was about to expire.
"I heard from my friends that the Garros Exchange purchases various magic materials, and I happen to have a few magic crystals on hand, so I wanted to take them over to see if I can exchange them for some money. "After all, the other party is old and not as strong as the two unlucky guys outside the door. No matter how unhappy Lin Li is, he can only suppress his anger.
After speaking, he didn't bother the old man and took out the scroll bag that Ina gave him from his arms.
Then there was a "clattering" sound, and dozens of magic crystals rolled onto the counter.
Looking at the bright magic crystals, Kevin felt his scalp numb at the time. He didn't even need to look carefully. Just by the elemental fluctuations revealed on the magic crystals, he could feel that they were all at least level five. Warcraft was not a cow raised by someone's family. You could squeeze it as you wanted. With dozens of level five or above magic crystals, even if a mercenary team was dispatched, it would probably take more than ten days.
Kevin really couldn't understand why so many high-quality magic crystals fell into the hands of Lin Li alone...
The one who had the biggest reaction was the old man behind the counter.
The old guy looked drowsy just now. At this time, a large amount of magic crystals rolled out of the scroll bag. The old man's eyes lit up on the spot. He jumped up from the chair and threw himself on the counter. His reaction was so quick and agile, so how could he look like he was old?
"Manticore... bloodthirsty lizard... thunder beast, holy shit! Why are there still bipedal wyverns! "I saw the old man's eyes shining brightly, lying on the counter counting one by one, either whispering softly or exclaiming loudly. His expression and eyes were as perverted as he could be.
"This...are these all yours? "The two of them waited there for more than half an hour before the old guy raised his head from the pile of magic crystals and looked at Lin Li, as if the big bad wolf saw the little white rabbit.
"Basically, this is what happened..."
Lin Li nodded bravely, and when he was about to ask him if he would accept it, the old man slapped the table: "There are eight thousand gold coins in total, do you want to sell it? "
“Eight thousand gold coins? "Lin Li was a little confused. As a time traveler, he really had no idea about money in Anriel's world. He had no choice but to turn his head and look at Kevin for help.
“Ten thousand! "Kevin spit out a number decisively.
“Wait a minute…I need to discuss this. "
After all, ten thousand gold coins was a large amount, and the old man did not dare to make a decision on his own. He just told the two of them and hurried out of the counter. After the two waited there for a long time, they saw the old man coming back with a happy face. This time, he did not hesitate at all and directly collected the dozens of magic crystals: "Deal! "
